renderingInstructions: Reproduce the 69-page review with node tools/pray/bulk-original-print-62-visual-review.mjs --out /tmp/pray-original-62; do not rely on expiring actions artifact as permanent evidence.
scope: Word-sequence of the English proper prayer body only; not punctuation-exact diplomatic transcription, additional preparatory prayers, common prayer references, meditations, practices, French editions or indulgence grants.
auditPolicy: A completed body word-sequence check requires direct original-page-image inspection start to finish of the English proper prayer text. Page-image rendering and PDF text-layer overlap alone do NOT certify it. Verify the correct day boundaries instead of assuming the overlapping two-page best-hit window is the body.
